note: Balanced by measured duration. The classes of a shard run in parallel, except the non-parallel 'Thread hammers' collection, which runs alone at the end of the shard that has it (rest). MemoryTests and CategorySeriesMemoryTests ride with the second corrupt shard. Measured on one loaded 4-core machine on 2026-10-24 (the sum of the test times, and the shard's wall time): corrupt-a 9,800 s in 48 minutes, of which the two TTA classes are 940 s; corrupt-b 9,900 s in 71 minutes, since its memory tests do not run in parallel. So the TTA classes stay in corrupt-a, which finishes first. The Monkey's Audio damaged-input classes have a shard of their own, corrupt-c: they decode some of their variants, and measured about 15 minutes of CPU on a loaded four-core machine, which run side by side in four classes.
